# speckit decision status

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Report the decision tier's posture: dormant/enabled, transport, model, whether the `apiKeyEnv` variable is present, and the resolved provider for the `decision` role

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit decision status [OPTIONS]
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.

## Help

```text
speckit decision status --help
```
